howItWorks.body: Start with a children’s dress, quilted bag, or Bible bag.
Choose the available size, then select a primary fabric and a secondary fabric.
Your order is cut and sewn in Ottumwa, then shipped when it is finished. Current sewing time is about 2 to 3 weeks.

copy.fabricSectionBody: Choose a primary fabric for the main part of the piece and a secondary fabric for the lining, trim, ties, or contrast details. If you need help pairing them, ask Olivia before ordering.
aboutBody: LivLocal is my sewing business in Ottumwa, Iowa. I make children’s dresses, quilted bags, and Bible bags one order at a time.
I do the cutting, sewing, pressing, and finishing myself. I started with children’s clothing and added bags as I worked through new patterns.
Choose the item, size, and fabrics you want. If you need something different, send me a message and I’ll let you know what is possible.
copy.ctaBandTitle: Need a different size or fabric?
copy.ctaBandBody: Send Olivia the details before ordering. She can confirm availability, timing, and any price change.

faq.q: How long until my order ships?
faq.a: Current sewing time is about 2 to 3 weeks. Shipping usually takes another 3 to 5 business days.

faq.q: How do sizes work on the kids pieces?
faq.a: Dress sizes run from 0 to 3 months through 7 to 8 years. The price shown on the product page updates when you choose a size.
The primary fabric is used for the main part of the piece. The secondary fabric is used for the lining, trim, ties, or contrast details.

faq.q: Can I pick a fabric that is not listed?
faq.a: Possibly. Send Olivia a message with what you are looking for before ordering. She will confirm availability, timing, and any price change.
Made-to-order pieces are cut for the size and fabrics you select. If your order arrives damaged or does not match what you ordered, contact Olivia so she can make it right.

faq.q: Do you ship outside the United States?
faq.a: Not at this time. Online shipping is currently limited to the United States.
Local pickup is not available through online checkout yet. Contact Olivia before ordering if you are near Ottumwa and want to ask about pickup.

faq.q: Can I order a custom size or a custom piece?
faq.a: Send the details through the contact page. Olivia will confirm whether she can make it, how long it will take, and what it will cost.
